meta.name: design-is
meta.description: Audit a design against Dieter Rams' ten "Good design is..." principles, then hand off a /make-plan prompt for one of three outcomes — new design, refine design, or redesign. Use when the user says "audit this design", "design review", "check this UI against Rams", "is this UI good", "critique this design", "design audit", or asks for a critique that should lead to a plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 对照迪特·拉姆斯十大原则审核设计并生成改进方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要依据经典设计原则来评估和优化界面设计。
copy.tagline_en: Audit designs against Dieter Rams' ten principles and generate improvement plans
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to evaluate and improve interface designs based on classic design principles.

howto.what: Claude 会先确认审计范围,再按 Dieter Rams 的十条原则逐条打分(0–3)并附证据,给出“新建、细化或重做”的裁决,最后输出一段可直接使用的 /make-plan 移交提示。
howto.when: 当用户说“audit this design”“design review”“design audit”等,或要求对设计做批评并导向后续计划时触发。

say.text: 按 Rams 十原则审计这个设计,给出分数和裁决。
say.note: Claude 会逐条打分并输出裁决。

say.text: 帮我把这个 UI 评审一下,最后给一个 /make-plan 提示。
say.note: 会生成可直接粘贴的计划提示。

say.text: 这个设计该重做还是细化?用十条原则打分并给证据。
say.note: 会给出裁决和证据锚点。

howto.what_en: When asked to audit a design, Claude first locks the scope, then scores it against Dieter Rams' ten principles (0–3 each) with evidence, decides NEW / REFINE / REDESIGN, and outputs a ready-to-run /make-plan handoff prompt.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user says 'audit this design', 'design review', 'design audit', etc., or asks for a critique that should lead to a plan.

say_en.text: Audit this design against Rams' ten principles, with scores and a verdict.
say_en.note: Claude will score each principle and summarize a verdict.

say_en.text: Review this UI and end with a /make-plan prompt I can use.
say_en.note: A copy-pasteable plan prompt will be generated.

say_en.text: Redesign or refine this design? Score it on Rams' ten principles with evidence.
say_en.note: You'll get a verdict and evidence anchors.
